name: aml_screener
description: Port of ole-eval code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/aml_screener. Ordered rules: mandatory BLOCK on sanctioned country, then BLOCK >= 70, REVIEW >= 25, else CLEAR. Python arithmetic (crypto +30, large_amount +25, high_risk_country +35, exchange +20, near_threshold +15) folded into a single model-judged composite_risk score.

sanctioned_country.instructions: Is origin or destination country in the sanctioned set (CU, IR, KP, SY)?

crypto_exchange_counterparty.instructions: Is the counterparty type a crypto exchange?

high_risk_country.instructions: Is origin or destination country in the high-risk set (BY, MM, NG, RU + sanctioned)?

aml_risk.instructions: Composite AML risk 0-100 (sum rule points for crypto +30, large_amount +25, high_risk_country +35, crypto_exchange +20, near_threshold +15, charity_high_risk +20).
